headline: GLACIER Did WHAT?! Nepal Floods Are INSANE ❄️💥🌊
text:
THE 🏔️ NEPAL TIBET 🏔️ BORDER 🛂 just 😤 got POUNDED 💥 by a CATASTROPHIC 🌊 FLASH 💦 FLOOD 🌊 that 🌋 KILLED ☠️ at least 469 PEOPLE 👥 and left 😭 MORE than 800 MISSING 🕵️‍♂️ after the whole thing just BURST 💥!! PreCUMliminary 🧐 investigations 🔬 pointed ☝️ to a COLLAPSED 🫠 GLACIER ❄️ as the cause of that flash flood highlighting rapidly MELTING 🫠 Himalayan 🏔️ ice 🧊 that has everyone 😱 realizing the mountains 🏔️ are DRIPPING 💧 bad 😩. Initial 📋 reports 📣 of an EARTHQUAKE 🌍 led many to believe a tremor caused a LANDSLIDE 🪨 and the flood 🌊 but 🙄 the US 🦅 Geological 🧪 Survey clarified 📢 it was 😮 actually a GLACIAL 🧊 CUMLAPSE 💦 which registered 📏 a magnitude 📊 of 5.2 ❗ that SLAMMED 🥊 the area 🗺️ like 🤔 a MOUNTAIN 🏔️ CLIMAX 😳 after years ⏳ of getting 🌡️ HOTTER 🥵 and HOTTER 🔥 no cap!!

DR SIMON DADDY 🐺 TOLD 📣 the BBC 📺 his TEAM 👥 HAD DETECTED 🔎 that the LOWER ⬇️ PART of a GLACIER ❄️ in NEPAL 🏔️ near the LANGTANG LIRUNG PEAK 🏔️ which is APPROXIMATELY 15km 📏 WEST 🧭 of the SITE 📍 of the FLOODS 🌊 HAD CUMLAPSED 💦 in a NORTHWESTERLY 🧭 DIRECTION ➡️ and then TRAVELLED 🚶 WESTWARDS ⬅️ DOWNSTREAM 🏞️ after what must have been one HELL 🥵 of a BUILDUP 🏗️!! The way this GLACIER ❄️ just COLLAPSED 🙇‍♂️ and SLID 🛝 like it couldn't HOLD 🤲 BACK anymore HAS us SCREAMING 😱 because DR SIMON DADDY 🐺 really knows how to READ 📖 the SIGNS 📊 of a MASSIVE 🐘 RELEASE 💦 and honestly 🤭 it sounds like it was LONG 📏 OVERDUE 😩 with that WESTWARDS THRUST 🏹 being the CHERRY 🍒 on TOP 🔝 of this UNHINGED 🌀 ICY 🧊 CLIMAX 🌋💦 no cap 🧢!!

INTERNATIONAL 🏛️ CENTRE 🏛️ FOR INTEGRATED 🧪 MOUNTAIN 🏔️ DEVELOPMENT 📊 DROPPED 📣 AN ANALysis 🔬 that there could have been an ICE 🧊 ROCK 🪨 ANALanche 🌋 originating 🧗 from a HIGH 🏔️ ALTITUDE 🏔️ area that caused a LARGE 💪 VOLUME 💦 of ice 🧊 and rock 🪨 DEBRIS 🪨 to ENTER 🚪 the LENDE KHOLA 🏞️ a TRIBUTARY 🏞️ of the BHOTE KOSHI 🏞️ river 🏞️ generating ⚡ a SUDDEN 🌊 SURGE 💦 carrying 🚚 water 💧 sediment and LARGE 🪨 BOULDERS 🪨 downstream ⬇️ the CENTRE 🏛️ FOUND 🔎 that water 💧 LEVELS 📈 in rivers 🏞️ downstream ⬇️ ROSE 📈 by between seven and nine METRES 📏 within a SPAN ⏳ of 30 ⏰ MINUTES ⌛ and several water 💧 MONITORING 📡 STATIONS 🏬 were WASHED 🌊 AWAY 🧹 or DAMAGED 💥🌊

MIKE 🧑‍🔬 SEARLE 🗣️ SAID 🗯️ THAT 🧐 this 🫱 whole 🌀 PROCESS 🌀 from 🏔️ LANDSLIDE 🪨 to 🌊 FLOOD 🌊 could 🫡 have 🫳 TAKEN ⏰ HOURS 🕒 or 🔄 even 🌙 DAYS 📅!! The 🕵️ SHEER 🏋️ WAVE 🌊 of 🧱 deCUMbris 🧱 suggests 🤔 there 🕵️ could 🫡 have 🫳 been a LANDSLIDE 🪨 FIRST 🥇 the 💧 WATER 💧 BUILT 🏗️ UP ⬆️ DAMMED 🚧 the 🏞️ RIVER 🏞️ and 🔗 then 🕒 it 💣 BURST 💥 in 📍 one 😳 HUGE 😱 great 🔥 FLOOD 🌊 he 🧔 told 🗣️ the 📢 BBC 📺!! The 🗺️ TOPOGRAPHY 🗺️ of 🏔️ the 🏔️ AREA 🏘️ with 😮 incredibly 🏔️ STEEP ⛰️ VALLEYS 🏞️ on 📍 both 👥 sides 🏞️ of 🏔️ LANGTANG 🏔️ LIRUNG 🏔️ could 🫡 have 🫳 FUNNELLED 🌀 the 💧 WATER 💧 at 🎯 higher 🏔️ SPEEDS 🏎️ like 😏 those 🏔️ steep 🪜 valleys 🏞️ were 🏋️ RAILING 💦 it to a THOROUGH 🥵 CLIMAX 💦💥 after the LONG 🕒 BUILDUP 🧱!!

ITS ❄️ STILL ❓ UNCLEAR 🤔 what ❓ CAUSED 🔥 the 🏔️ GLACIER 🧊 to 💥 COLLAPSE 🪨 after that 🥴 madness 😵‍💫 Searle 🗣️ said 🗣️ that Langtang ⛰️ Lirung has been 🐢 SLOWLY 📈 RISING due 🌋 to long-term TECTONIC 🌍 MOVEMENT 🏗️ its like 🛠️ PUTTING a JACK 🔧 under 🚗 the car and then 🍆 JACKING 🥵 it UP ⬆️ as the 🏔️ mountain rises 📈 the glacier 🧊 gets STEEPER 😩 and even STEEPER 📐 and its INEVITABLE ☠️ that parts of it FALL 💦 OFF but usually these are SMALLER 🪨 chunks which are EASILY 🚽 FLUSHED OUT however in this 🔥 DISASTER the whole ❄️ glacier seems to have CUMLAPSED 💦💥 in one single GO 🚀 which is VERY 😱 UNUSUAL and lowkey the whole process feels like a massive built up 🥵 RELEASE 🫠 fr fr 💯!!

HIMALAYAS 🏔️ UPLIFTING ⬆️ combined with CLIMATE 🥵 CHANGE 🔥 and increasingly high TEMPERATURES 🌡️ are making GLACIERS ❄️ MELT 🫠 like crazy causing those NEPAL 🌊 FLOODS 🌊 because of TECTONICS 🏗️ and all that ice loss 📉 at DOUBLE 2️⃣ the rate since 2000 per one ICIMOD 📊 analysis!! Dr. Simon DADDY 🍑 Cook pointed 👉 out similar incidents of floods 🌊 and landslides 🪨 caused by glacier 🧊 collapses in INDIA 🇮🇳 SWITZERLAND 🇨🇭 and ITALY 🇮🇹 in recent years including the 2021 CHAMOLI 💥 event that killed 200 people with impact equivalent to 15 atomic bombs 💣💥!! The increasing frequency 📈 of hazards ⚠️ in the cryosphere ❄️ is beCUMming 🥴 more visible 👀 than ever before and with a warming planet 🌍 you get more landslides 🏔️ debris flows 🌀 and glacier collapses 🧊 because climate warming destabilises high mountain environments 🏞️ "honestly the cryosphere is getting RAILED 💦" admitted one observer 😳 and no cap we are all down bad for Dr. Simon Daddy tho 🍆!!
